schemas.name: asset
schemas.title: Asset, v1
schemas.note: An asset as an avenDB entry of kind asset, in avenDB's own schema subset: title, group, name, version, note, licence, its files by role, tags (avendb/crates/avendb/tests/assets.rs reads these bytes with avenDB's parser)

schemas.name: card
schemas.title: Asset card, v1
schemas.note: What an asset's build says of it: its ref, recipe hash and engine, group, id, version, variant, label, real size, triangles, catalog of parts, declared parameters, solver sliders, measures, levels of detail and impostor; read by our checker (./check.js), never by avenDB
